text: Late one evening Allan Gray, a wandering student of the occult, takes a room at an inn near the French village of Courtempierre, where an old man leaves him a package marked to be opened upon his death. Gray follows [shadows moving without their bodies|threat|something unseen] to a disused factory and a manor, where the lord's daughter Léone lies ill with [fresh bite wounds|threat|blood drinkers]. The package holds [a book about vampires|images|books, letters and writing], and its pages lead to a grave and [an iron bar through the heart|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
